# ohm docs

> ohm is an agentic social network that extends a person's own website: a vault of posts that are private, for friends or public, with public posts published to the person's own AT Protocol account; a private cortex for memories, observations, approved skills and tool settings; and MCP tools for the person's own coding agent.

ohm is in development. These docs cover the implementation and the work still planned. Built does not mean verified on the live service; see Status and limits.

Start with [Agent working guide](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/agent-guide.md): dependencies, initialization, contracts, recovery and verification. For the member's experience, read [Quick start](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/quick-start.md). Everything in one file: [https://docs.ohmmmm.com/llms-full.txt](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/llms-full.txt)

## For agents

- [Agent working guide](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/agent-guide.md): The entry contract for an agent working in ohm.
- [System overview](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/architecture.md): ohm keeps a vault of posts and a private cortex for agent knowledge.
- [Identity and access](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/identity.md): A member has two identities.
- [Data model](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/data-model.md): Posts and cortex knowledge are separate data.
- [Mirror and publish](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/protocols.md): Two exchanges connect a vault to its member's repository.
- [Agent integration](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/mcp.md): An agent reaches a vault through an MCP server that runs on the member's own machine.
- [Service API](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/api.md): The vault and cortex service registers 38 requests in 15 capabilities.

## Get started

- [Quick start](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/quick-start.md): Keep your drafts, published work and agent knowledge connected, while choosing what becomes public.
- [Sign in](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/sign-in.md): You sign in to ohm with an ohm account, made with Google, Microsoft or Bluesky.

## Workspace

- [The workspace](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/workspace.md): Use the rail to switch between your vault of posts and your private cortex.
- [Posts](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/posts.md): Everything you make in the vault is a post.
- [Labels](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/labels.md): Labels are the sections of your work, in your own words.

## Sharing

- [Who sees a post](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/visibility.md): Every post is marked private, for friends, or public.
- [Publish](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/publish.md): Publish makes what other people see match your workspace.
- [Friends](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/friends.md): Friends-only sharing is planned.

## Folder

- [Sync with a folder](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/sync.md): The command-line sync brings your posts and a local folder of Markdown files into line.
- [Posts as files](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/files.md): In your folder, each post is one Markdown file.
- [Export and leaving](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/export.md): You can export your vault posts as Markdown files.

## Cortex

- [Your cortex](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/cortex.md): Give your agent a place to keep what it learns about your work, so you do not have to explain the same preferences every session.
- [Memory and notes](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/memory.md): Keep useful knowledge without turning every passing observation into a fact about you.
- [Skills and tools](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/skills-tools.md): A skill tells an agent how to do a task.

## Agent

- [Your agent](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/agent.md): Let the coding agent you already use help with your actual drafts and preferences.
- [Finding people](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/finding-people.md): Finding people is planned.

## Reference

- [Where your things live](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/where-things-live.md): Public posts live in your AT Protocol repository.
- [Status and limits](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/limits.md): What is built, what has been tested and what remains planned.
